name: Roundcube
description: Roundcube is a browser-based IMAP webmail client with a desktop-like interface. It handles folders, search, threads, HTML compose, attachments and an address book, and can be extended with plugins and skins.

notes.text: Roundcube is only a mail client: sign in with an account of your existing IMAP server. Without an IMAP host preset, the login page asks for the server.
Without an SMTP host preset, mail is sent through the IMAP server on port 587. Change imap_host and smtp_host in /opt/roundcube/config/config.inc.php if needed.

app_vars.name: var_imap_host
app_vars.label: IMAP Host
app_vars.help: e.g. ssl://mail.example.com:993; empty shows a server field on the login page

app_vars.name: var_smtp_host
app_vars.label: SMTP Host
app_vars.help: e.g. tls://mail.example.com:587; empty uses the IMAP host on port 587
